name: @acme/core-slots
description: Registry placeholder for the @acme/core slot (socket) package. It is auto-installed as @acme/core's required peer and is never wired: stunt-double's adapter answers @acme/core-slots/* in configured tools, and the universal tier links the project's own package under this name. Any tool that resolves THIS package was not wired, and fails at resolve time on purpose.
